integrity: Proof supplies explicit square coordinate equations, exhaustive image constructions and fiber partitions; two finite field enumerations reproduce every target fiber.
scientific_limitations: Valid for five-by-five unitriangular groups in characteristic two; root counts require a finite field. Prior width threshold and image counts for q=2,4 are credited; larger dimensions, odd characteristics, and other power words are not determined. Historical priority remains provisional and computational checks at q=2 and q=4 do not prove infinite statements.
title: Exact square-root fibers in the five-by-five unitriangular group
